statement: For positive rank-one couplings and arbitrary zero-sum real frequencies, the minimum number of real phase equilibria modulo common phase shift is zero.

answer.text: Equation (3) gives |omega_i|≤(k_i/n)sum_{j≠i}k_j for every real equilibrium. For any positive coupling vector, one can choose a zero-sum frequency vector violating this inequality, on an open set. Thus the minimum real equilibrium count in this family is exactly 0.

source.location: §1 equation (3); §3.1 Proposition 3.3 and its proof, PDF pp.2 and 8–9

notes:
This zero minimum is a direct consequence of the displayed equilibrium equations; it is not claimed as a separately numbered zero-count theorem. Real means phase equilibria modulo a common shift, not real Laurent coordinates. Frequencies are arbitrary zero-sum real inputs.
